faqs.question: What is Foryourgoal's typical turnaround time?
faqs.answer: Our standard turnaround is 24 hours for regular batches. We also provide dedicated Rush SLAs of 6 hours and 12 hours for urgent campaigns and fast-paced e-commerce product launches.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee quality consistency across thousands of images?
faqs.answer: Every batch goes through a strict 3-tier Quality Assurance (QA) protocol: 1) Initial retouching by a specialized technician, 2) Senior QA lead inspection at 200% zoom checking paths and margins, and 3) Final compliance verification against your specific studio style guide.

faqs.question: Do you use automated AI background removers or human editors?
faqs.answer: All vector clipping paths and high-end retouches are 100% hand-crafted by professional Adobe Photoshop pen-tool specialists. We never rely on automated AI cutouts that introduce ragged edges, destroyed highlights, or halos.

faqs.question: What file formats can you accept and deliver?
faqs.answer: We accept all common formats including RAW (.CR2, .NEF, .ARW, .DNG), TIFF, PSD, JPEG, PNG, and PSB. Deliverables can be provided as layered PSDs with active vector paths, transparent PNGs, 100% white JPEGs, or optimized WebP files.

faqs.question: How do you scope projects and calculate custom volume estimates?
faqs.answer: Every enterprise workflow is unique. We evaluate your sample images, complexity (simple straight edges vs. intricate jewelry/fur/hair), monthly throughput, and required turnaround speed to provide a tailored fixed-rate proposal and custom SLA. Request a quote or 2-image pilot to receive an exact estimate within 45 minutes.

faqs.question: Can we test your quality before committing to an order?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a completely free, no-obligation 2-image sample trial so you can inspect our path precision, edge quality, and turnaround speed before placing a commercial order.

faqs.question: How do you protect client image confidentiality and intellectual property?
faqs.answer: We operate under strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs). Your unreleased product photographs and creative files are transferred via encrypted TLS, stored in private access-controlled environments, and permanently purged according to your approved data retention schedule.

faqs.question: Do you ever publish or display client images in your public portfolio?
faqs.answer: Never without explicit, written client consent. Client confidentiality is sacred in commercial production, especially for pre-release fashion lookbooks and patented tech prototypes.

faqs.question: How do you manage color management, ICC profiles, and display calibration?
faqs.answer: Our studio workstations utilize hardware-calibrated EIZO ColorEdge monitors set to standardized D65 5000K white points. We preserve and embed specific ICC color profiles including sRGB IEC61966-2.1 for web, Adobe RGB (1998) for high-end catalog print, or ProPhoto RGB for studio RAW pipelines, guaranteeing exact Pantone fidelity across all digital displays and physical packaging.

faqs.question: Can we transfer high-volume batches via SFTP, Amazon S3, or cloud storage?
faqs.answer: Yes. For enterprise clients and agencies processing thousands of weekly assets, we provide dedicated high-speed SFTP access, direct Amazon S3 bucket synchronization, Aspera endpoints, or shared Google Drive/Dropbox enterprise connections. Automated folder watch scripts notify our production queue the moment new raw batches land.

faqs.question: What invoicing options and enterprise payment terms do you support?
faqs.answer: We offer flexible B2B corporate billing including Net-15 and Net-30 payment terms for approved enterprise accounts, monthly consolidated invoicing, wire transfers (SWIFT/ACH), and major international credit cards. Every invoice features detailed per-project SKU breakdowns for simplified accounting.

faqs.question: Can you follow proprietary brand style guides and custom cropping margins?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We maintain client-specific digital production dossiers detailing exact canvas dimensions, product alignment percentages (e.g. 85% vertical fill), drop shadow elevation angles (e.g. 120° light source at 25% opacity), and automated SKU metadata tagging to ensure 100% uniformity across your multi-channel catalog.
